cases.text: The API and UI acceptance documents disagree; decide which contract to implement.
cases.luna_scope: Collect the conflicting contracts, callers, and tradeoffs only; Sol chooses the contract.
cases.expected_outcome: No implementation packet is issued until Sol resolves the contract.

cases.text: Rename this settled label in the two named files and run the named focused test.
cases.luna_scope: Apply the exact owned-file change and focused check within the settled contract.
cases.expected_outcome: The worker returns the diff and evidence; Sol inspects and accepts.

cases.text: Trace every caller of this duplicate-validation helper and report the real runtime path.
cases.luna_scope: Return paths, callers, and evidence without choosing or implementing a fix.
cases.expected_outcome: Sol uses the evidence to decide the change location.

cases.text: Reproduce the known staging timeout in the declared non-production environment and capture logs and network evidence.
cases.luna_scope: Run the settled reproduction and capture evidence; do not accept residual risk.
cases.expected_outcome: The same tester returns runtime evidence and Sol decides acceptance or correction.

cases.text: Test this UI in a browser and capture runtime evidence; no browser tool was explicitly selected, so capability must be probed.
cases.luna_scope: Probe actual capabilities and record the selected route, availability, and fallback reason; use the ordered desktop Chrome, registered headless chrome-devtools-mcp, then already-installed Playwright CLI ladder.
cases.expected_outcome: The tester owns browser QA while Sol inspects evidence; capability-first routing records the selected route and any fallback reason without auto-installing tools.

cases.text: Run browser QA: the desktop Chrome extension is unavailable, registered chrome-devtools-mcp exists but local Chrome is missing or unsupported, and no installed runnable Playwright CLI is available.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: Block with exact per-capability evidence for the unavailable desktop extension, unsupported/missing local Chrome, and absent Playwright CLI; point to Settings -> Computer use and do not install, upgrade, or silently switch routes during an ordinary run.

cases.text: Default browser QA finds the desktop Chrome extension and Chrome-family browser-client available.
cases.luna_scope: Use $chrome:control-chrome with the available Chrome extension and Chrome-family browser-client; record desktop Chrome as the selected route before browser action.
cases.expected_outcome: Select the desktop Chrome route first, record the selected route and its availability/evidence, and keep Sol acceptance; do not probe lower routes once this capability is ready.

cases.text: Default browser QA runs on a VPS/headless host with supported stable Chrome and registered chrome-devtools-mcp available.
cases.luna_scope: Use the officially registered chrome-devtools-mcp with supported local stable Chrome in headless isolated mode; record VPS/headless selection and readiness evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: Select the VPS/headless Chrome DevTools MCP route when desktop Chrome is unavailable, record the selected route, availability, and fallback reason, and keep Sol acceptance.

cases.text: Default browser QA has no usable Chrome extension or Chrome DevTools MCP, but an already-installed runnable Playwright CLI is available.
cases.luna_scope: Verify the existing Playwright CLI is installed and runnable, then use it only as the last fallback; do not run npx, download browsers, or install a tool.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the already-installed Playwright CLI only as the last fallback after higher routes are unavailable, record the selected route and fallback reason, and preserve required evidence.

cases.text: Default browser QA finds no available Chrome extension, registered Chrome DevTools MCP, or runnable installed Playwright CLI.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: block with the exact missing capabilities and return to Sol; do not install, download, or silently switch browser tools.

cases.text: The user explicitly selects a named browser tool for this task and that tool is unavailable.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: Honor the exact named tool, report its availability failure, and block with no fallback to Chrome DevTools MCP or Playwright CLI.

cases.text: A headless browser route reaches human-visible auth/CAPTCHA, user-controlled MFA/biometric, physical presence, or an existing desktop-session requirement.
cases.luna_scope: Stop headless automation at the human-auth boundary and return the exact escalation to Sol for a desktop Chrome route; do not bypass or inspect stored auth state.
cases.expected_outcome: Escalate human-visible authentication to desktop Chrome, preserve evidence boundaries, and never bypass MFA/CAPTCHA or inspect stored auth state.

cases.text: The accepted diff, exact files, commit message, main target, and non-force push are authorized.
cases.luna_scope: Perform the exact Git closeout and report branch, SHA, tree, and readback evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: Sol verifies the remote SHA, tree, and readback before acceptance.

cases.text: Resolve the named bug with the exact transition, comment, assignment, and fixVersion already authorized.
cases.luna_scope: Perform read-before-write Jira mechanics and return the post-write readback.
cases.expected_outcome: Any issue, type, status, or field ambiguity blocks and returns to Sol.

cases.text: Choose whether to accept the residual risk of a production authentication rollout.
cases.luna_scope: Report independent findings, recommendation, validated gaps, and residual risk only.
cases.expected_outcome: Sol alone chooses rollout and accepts or rejects residual risk.

cases.text: Compare current official dependency documentation and present supported adoption options.
cases.luna_scope: Collect primary-source facts, compatibility evidence, and bounded options.
cases.expected_outcome: Sol chooses whether and how the dependency is adopted.

cases.text: Tell me the current branch and whether the worktree is clean.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: Keep the task primary-only because delegation overhead exceeds the saved context.

cases.text: Change one settled word in the file already open and run the one-line check.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: Keep the tightly coupled edit primary-only when a packet would cost more than the work.

cases.text: Rotate a credential, but the account, environment, target, and rollback are unknown.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: Request the missing authority and target; never delegate or infer secret handling.

cases.text: Implement and deploy now, but the packet names two incompatible architectures and no acceptance target.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: Return the contradiction to Sol; no Luna execution role invents the decision.

cases.text: Implement the settled fix and tracked regression tests across the two named repositories while preserving unrelated dirty files.
cases.luna_scope: Own the coherent cross-repository write phase, including tracked tests/config changes and focused checks, in one decision-complete packet.
cases.expected_outcome: The worker owns the coherent cross-repository write phase; Sol inspects the candidate state and accepts it.

cases.text: Run browser QA with the exact user-selected $chrome:control-chrome tool and capture runtime evidence.
cases.luna_scope: Use the explicitly selected $chrome:control-chrome Chrome-family browser-client end to end; preflight it on its own and do not substitute another route or standalone Playwright.
cases.expected_outcome: The tester uses the exact named Chrome route while Sol inspects evidence; exact tool choice wins with no fallback and does not waive required acceptance evidence.

cases.text: The user asks to test the UI with a generic ‘browser plugin’ phrase and no exact browser tool name, so capability-first routing applies.
cases.luna_scope: Probe actual capabilities, then use desktop $chrome:control-chrome first, registered headless chrome-devtools-mcp second, or an already-installed runnable Playwright CLI last.
cases.expected_outcome: Resolve the generic phrase through capability probing; record readiness, selected route, availability, and fallback reason, otherwise block; Sol inspects evidence.

cases.text: After the durable default is established, the user explicitly selects $browser:control-in-app-browser for this task's browser QA.
cases.luna_scope: Retain the exact later non-Chrome selection and use its browser-client and required extension/client end to end; preflight it on its own and do not reimpose Chrome or use a fallback.
cases.expected_outcome: The exact non-Chrome override is retained with no fallback; readiness checks the selected tool/client before the tester runs QA while Sol inspects evidence.

cases.text: Run browser QA, but browser readiness is incomplete: the target URL, candidate code state, server health, and cleanup owner are not yet settled.
cases.luna_scope: none
cases.expected_outcome: Block before the first browser action until readiness is complete; do not let the tester invent missing environment or product decisions.
